name: Wonder Woman
hook: Amazon princess, lasso of truth, Lynda Carter's spin, and Gal Gadot's blockbuster.

facts.label: Diana Prince
facts.statement: Diana Prince is Wonder Woman, an Amazon princess who fights crime with a tiara and a magic lasso.

facts.label: Lynda Carter
facts.statement: Lynda Carter played Diana Prince for three seasons on TV and was Maybelline's Beauty & Fashion Director.

facts.label: the lasso of truth
facts.statement: Her lasso forces anyone caught in it to tell the truth; her invisible plane and boomerang tiara are other tools.

facts.label: Gal Gadot
facts.statement: Gal Gadot first played Wonder Woman in Batman v Superman, then headlined the 2017 film set in World War I.

facts.label: Patty Jenkins
facts.statement: Patty Jenkins directed 2017's Wonder Woman, becoming the first woman to direct a $100 million superhero movie.

facts.label: DC Comics
facts.statement: Wonder Woman has been a DC Comics character since the 1940s and a founding member of the Justice League.

facts.label: Steve Trevor
facts.statement: Chris Pine played Steve Trevor in 2017's Wonder Woman after playing Captain Kirk in the Star Trek reboot.
